reason: The ObsNum 150818 event review proves that a geometry-correct compact crossing can be fit poorly by the single common-centroid forward model; raw detector-weighted SSE is therefore not the corpus estimator.

source_quality.overlapping_geometric_window_rule: within one detector-scan, partition adjacent accepted event windows at floor((closest_i+closest_j)/2)+1 so every scored sample belongs to at most one local centroid
source_quality.template: fixed PPT elliptical Gaussian translated only along the local tau-zero event trajectory
source_quality.score: maximum Pearson correlation after local mean removal over the symmetric spatial grid
source_quality.qualification: finite interior peak, positive amplitude, and correlation at or above threshold

centroid_estimator.measurement: parabolic refinement of the matched-filter maximum expressed as signed along-trajectory angular displacement from the PPT center

models.joint: sum of the lag and hysteresis terms

centroid_estimator.sign_convention: positive tau evaluates telescope coordinates later, so the source centroid in recorded-coordinate space shifts by -velocity*tau
centroid_estimator.base_weight: each detector has unit total weight divided equally among its qualified events
centroid_estimator.robust_loss: Huber IRLS with one common constant-model MAD scale

required_visuals: individual compact-source-qualified and rejected event profiles
locally aligned qualified and rejected morphology stacks
measured-versus-predicted event centroids and robust residuals
truthful geometric, assessed, qualified, rejected, and fitted counts

interpretation.permitted: baseline point estimates, objective and threshold sensitivity, event residual diagnostics
interpretation.prohibited: formal significance, uncertainty, causal identification, universal correction, or release of non-anchor observations before owner review
